page.notes: Floral ornament between the subtitle and the imprint is a printer's device, not transcribed. Title-page capitals converted to u/v spelling (BRUTUM, FULMEN, UNA, CUM, MULTIPLICIS). Large spaced capitals in the title lines are reproduced as capitals. The line "Papæ SIXTI V." etc. is printed in mixed type, so letters such as "Serenissi." and "illu-" were read from the scan with normal confidence; no doubtful readings. The page has no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
